verdict.rationale: Built-in AI for asset chores is a fair question for a design editor, but the evidence shows no native image generation, background removal, content-aware fill or copy suggestions inside Penpot. What is documented is an MCP server that lets external AI agents connect to Penpot, plus a community plugin marketplace that includes AI tools. Both are adjacent building blocks or third-party extensions, not the product's own built-in capability.

support.subject: As a designer, built-in AI handles asset chores — image generation, background removal, content-aware fills, copy suggestions — inside the editor
